metatype:human.text: Human. Nothing special — which is exactly why nobody remembers your face. Use that.

metatype:elf.text: Pointy ears open doors uptown and close them in the Barrens. Know which street you're on.

metatype:dwarf.text: Dwarves see in the dark and shrug off what kills the rest of us. Short jokes are fatal. Mostly for the joker.

metatype:ork.text: Tusks and a short fuse are what they expect. Give 'em a long memory instead.

metatype:troll.text: Doorframes are your natural enemy. Everything else is just scared of you.
